tested_scope: Serialized single-writer symbolic recurrence after durable intent I21(effect_id=e21,payload_hash=hA,generation=21,nonce=n21) exists but the effect certificate is absent. Target state is queried before replay. Query observations may be fresh, stale, partial, or identity-ambiguous. No concurrent writers, target corruption, nondeterministic effect ids, or distributed-consensus semantics are modeled.

policies.permissive_existence_only: If any target record with effect_id=e21 is visible, skip replay; otherwise replay.
policies.strict_fenced: Skip replay only when a target observation is certified fresh for generation>=21 and contains exact (effect_id=e21,payload_hash=hA,generation=21,nonce=n21). Replay only when a certified-fresh complete observation proves exact absence. On stale/partial observation or identity/payload/nonce conflict, neither skip nor replay; persist DEFER/UNRESOLVED until freshness+identity is certifiable.

aggregate_result.verdict: PASS for safety, not liveness: exact payload equality plus generation/nonce and freshness fencing prevents the tested false-skip and duplicate-replay failures by refusing to guess under stale, partial, or identity-ambiguous observations. It does not eliminate the capability gap: without a Chat-visible way to certify target-query freshness/completeness and effect identity, the safe action is DEFER, so exactly-once progress remains unresolved.

mechanism_revision: Treat target query as sensory feedback that must itself carry a freshness/identity reliability signal. Intent/efference-copy plus an unfenced observation is insufficient. Recovery therefore needs a three-way decision: CONFIRMED_APPLIED -> skip and recover certificate; CONFIRMED_FRESH_ABSENT -> replay; UNCERTAIN_OR_CONFLICT -> no semantic action, checkpoint and defer.
neuroscience_transfer: The role-local corollary-discharge analogy is refined from binary prediction-versus-observation matching to reliability-gated comparison: a self-action prediction should not be canceled by an observation whose provenance/freshness is uncertain. The recurrence analogue is to gate replay/skip on the reliability of the target-state observation, not merely on record presence.

mechanism_assessment.repository_transport_role: bounded role-local persistence/readback only; symbolic computation is performed in scheduled Chat, not by hosted runners or repository compute
mechanism_assessment.unresolved_child: A target that cannot expose a complete freshness/generation/nonce certificate (or equivalent linearizable/idempotent target semantics) cannot safely distinguish applied-from-unapplied after an ambiguous response. Safe recurrence can preserve state by DEFER, but cannot guarantee exactly-once progress until that observable capability exists.

conflict_check: Only frozen sanitized controls and own neuroscience state were used semantically. No O, other-worker, downstream, legacy, shared-ledger, other-role, protected-primary, hosted-compute, finite-credit, paid, scheduler, or manual-user execution semantics were used.
